name: addpipe24_cla_block4_kstree
rationale: Prior cla_block4 attempt computed cross-block carries via a flat, directly-expanded sum-of-products (each block's carry-in built from a growing AND-term expansion, e.g. cin[5] needs a 5-term OR with up to 4-literal ANDs), which likely maps to deeper multi-input gates for the later blocks and only reached WNS 7.436. Kogge-Stone-style prefix trees achieved near-baseline WNS (7.517) because every combine node is a simple 2-input AND/OR regardless of tree position (fan-in/logic depth stays low and uniform). This candidate keeps cla_block4's proven 4-bit block generate/propagate and intra-block carry-resolve logic (already formally verified structurally) but replaces the flat block-carry SOP with a proper 3-level Kogge-Stone-style prefix tree over just the 6 block G/P pairs. This should shorten the worst-case block-carry path to uniform 2-input combines (matching KS's favorable per-node delay) while keeping the total node count small (tree only spans 6 elements, not 24), aiming to land closer to KS/baseline WNS at area below both KS (549.8) and possibly below cla_block4 (520.8), improving the area/WNS trade on the observed frontier.
